about: Each state's motor fuel tax as a share of its selective sales taxes, the budget source the fuel tax is collected under. Census Bureau, 2022 Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, line 13 (motor fuel tax) over line 12 (selective sales taxes), state government column, as read into data/research/money/state-local-finances-2022.json. D.C. has no separate state column, so its row is the combined column. Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands are not in the survey and take the 50-state figure, 0.285, ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE.
